Overview

PT. Megaspeed International Indonesia is specialized in providing AI computing resources and comprehensive solutions aimed at advancing network, computing, and intelligence technologies. Megaspeed International is a premier business partner of NVIDIA, strategically positioned in the Asia Pacific region. Our partnership with NVIDIA affords us privileged access to cutting-edge products, services, and cloud computing capabilities, enabling us to drive innovation and foster sustained growth for our clients. Our advanced computing platforms cater to a myriad of applications, including urban governance, autonomous driving, intelligent finance, gaming, and image recognition. We offer a wide range of technological solutions, empowering various industries with capabilities such as visual modelling, cloud-edge-end inference, distributed AI training, inference, distributed AI training, inference acceleration engines, model evaluation, and more. At Megaspeed, we are committed to delivering exceptional services tailored to meet the unique requirements of our clients. Our offerings include cloud services, customized solutions, and strategic partnerships with other industry suppliers. We are dedicated to fostering technological innovation, driving business transformation, and empowering our clients to thrive in an increasingly complex and dynamic marketplace. With our strategic partnerships, cutting-edge solutions, and unwavering commitment to excellence, we are poised to shape the future of AI computing in the Asia Pacific region and beyond.


Website 

https://megaspeed.ai/


Industry

IT Services and IT Consulting


Onsite workplace

Our workplace ethos: work hard, work smart. We value productivity, innovation, and growth. Join us where your efforts are recognized and make a real impact.


Responsibilities: 

1. Policy Analysis & Compliance:

Track and interpret relevant laws and regulations to ensure business practices align with compliance requirements, minimizing policy-related risks.

2. Licensing and Regulatory Management:

Oversee the proper registration and management of all licenses, including basic company licenses, import permits and more.

Monitor all licensing documents, ensuring payment, paperwork, and reporting requirements are met promptly.

Estimate and track the progress of all licensing processes; intervene directly to resolve delays as needed, coordinating with internal teams to prevent miscommunication or missing information.

Maintain control over the validity of all licenses, renewing or updating as necessary.

Assess, research, and interpret new government regulations, providing timely advice to management on compliance implications.

Develop and recommend licensing strategies that align with business objectives.

Review new government regulations relevant to the business to anticipate compliance needs.

Establish and maintain strong relationships with relevant external institutions to facilitate smooth licensing processes, especially in cases where regulatory restrictions or missing documents present challenges.

3. Government Relations:

Establish and nurture strong relationships with government agencies and regulatory bodies to enhance the company's influence and reputation.

4. Policy Advocacy:

Support advocacy for favourable public policies, working to secure government backing and resources that benefit the company.

5. Crisis Management:

Manage government-related crises, coordinating communication strategies to mitigate potential negative impacts on the company.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, with at least 5 years of relevant experience; not only an expert in regulations but also knowledgeable in how to process licenses.

  • Familiar with industry policies and skilled in government relationship management.

  • Able to build and maintain coordination with officers from government bodies at middle to upper levels; capable of handling various types of licenses, processes, and reporting (LKPM, Import Report, TDPSE, KBLI, etc.).

  • Excellent communication, coordination, and crisis management skills.

  • Able to communicate in English, with a network of government officers and the ability to maintain good communication with both central and local governments.

  • Ability to travel and work flexible hours as required.

  • Familiar with the postal and digital business across all government platforms such as OSS RBA, INSW, and Postel.

  • Familiar with reports from various government institutions: BKPM, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Manpower, Directorate General of Taxes, Ministry of Communication and Informatics (Kominfodigi), Customs, Ministry of Industry, etc.

  • Knowledge of import reporting obligations and requirements, including compliance with regulations on import activities and relevant reporting procedures.

jobs.description: Job Description Mengembangkan konsep dan desain interior sesuai kebutuhan proyek, identitas produk, serta standar perusahaan. Menyusun, meninjau, dan memastikan kelengkapan gambar kerja, gambar konstruksi, spesifikasi teknis, detail interior, serta pemilihan material. Berkoordinasi dengan konsultan, kontraktor interior, dan divisi terkait selama proses perencanaan hingga pelaksanaan proyek. Melakukan review desain, evaluasi teknis, serta memberikan solusi terhadap kendala yang terjadi di lapangan. Memastikan pekerjaan interior dilaksanakan sesuai dengan desain yang telah disetujui, standar kualitas, anggaran, dan target waktu penyelesaian proyek. Melakukan monitoring progres proyek serta memberikan rekomendasi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi desain dan kualitas pelaksanaan. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 Arsitektur Interior, Interior Design, Arsitektur, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 5 tahun di Konsultan Interior dan Kontraktor Interior (pengalaman menangani proyek hotel menjadi nilai tambah). Menguasai AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, Adobe Photoshop, dan Adobe Illustrator. Menguasai software rendering seperti Enscape, Lumion, atau 3Ds Max menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai material interior, detail konstruksi, spesifikasi material, dan metode pelaksanaan pekerjaan interior. Memiliki kemampuan leadership, komunikasi, problem solving, serta koordinasi yang baik dengan berbagai stakeholder. Bersedia bekerja onsite di Bekasi

jobs.title: SALES ADMINISTRATION
jobs.description: Bergabunglah Bersama PT Graithlene Sukses Indonesia PT Graithlene Sukses Indonesia sedang membuka kesempatan bagi Anda yang teliti, terorganisir, dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik untuk bergabung sebagai Sales Administration . Pada posisi ini, Anda akan berperan penting dalam mendukung aktivitas tim Sales, mulai dari pengelolaan dokumen, pemrosesan pesanan pelanggan, hingga koordinasi pengiriman barang. Jika Anda menyukai pekerjaan yang membutuhkan ketelitian dan mampu bekerja dalam tim, kami ingin mengenal Anda. Tanggung Jawab Menyiapkan dan merekap Sales Quotation serta dokumen penawaran. Mengelola dan memperbarui database pelanggan. Memproses Sales Order serta berkoordinasi dengan tim terkait mengenai ketersediaan stok. Menyiapkan dokumen penjualan, seperti Surat Jalan, Invoice, dan dokumen pendukung lainnya. Melakukan koordinasi dengan tim logistik untuk proses pengiriman barang. Melakukan follow-up administrasi penjualan dan penagihan (collection) kepada pelanggan. Menyusun laporan administrasi penjualan secara berkala. Memberikan dukungan administrasi kepada tim Sales agar proses penjualan berjalan dengan lancar. Kualifikasi Kami mencari kandidat yang memiliki: Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 dari semua jurusan (Administrasi, Manajemen, Akuntansi, atau jurusan terkait lebih diutamakan). Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Sales Admin, Admin Penjualan, atau posisi administrasi lainnya. Terampil menggunakan Microsoft Office, terutama Microsoft Excel. Memiliki kemampuan administrasi, dokumentasi, dan pengarsipan yang baik. Teliti, rapi, mampu mengatur prioritas pekerjaan, dan memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Benefit Gaji kompetitif. BPJS Kesehatan & BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. Bonus berdasarkan kinerja dan performance. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional dan suportif. Kesempatan belajar dan berkembang bersama perusahaan yang terus bertumbuh. Tentang PT Graithlene Sukses Indonesia PT Graithlene Sukses Indonesia adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang solusi alat ukur warna (Color Measurement Solutions) dan merupakan authorized distributor berbagai merek internasional terkemuka. Kami melayani berbagai industri seperti: Plastik Cat & Coating Tekstil Otomotif Makanan & Minuman Kemasan Pulp & Paper Kosmetik Farmasi Building Material Dengan pengalaman dan komitmen terhadap kualitas, kami terus menghadirkan solusi terbaik melalui produk premium serta layanan purna jual yang profesional. Siap Bergabung dengan Kami? Jika Anda adalah pribadi yang teliti, terorganisir, dan menyukai pekerjaan administrasi, kami mengundang Anda untuk bergabung bersama PT Graithlene Sukses Indonesia sebagai Sales Administration. Kirimkan lamaran Anda sekarang dan jadilah bagian dari tim kami!

Bergabunglah Bersama PT Graithlene Sukses Indonesia

PT Graithlene Sukses Indonesia sedang membuka kesempatan bagi Anda yang teliti, terorganisir, dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik untuk bergabung sebagai Sales Administration.

Pada posisi ini, Anda akan berperan penting dalam mendukung aktivitas tim Sales, mulai dari pengelolaan dokumen, pemrosesan pesanan pelanggan, hingga koordinasi pengiriman barang. Jika Anda menyukai pekerjaan yang membutuhkan ketelitian dan mampu bekerja dalam tim, kami ingin mengenal Anda.


Tanggung Jawab

  1. Menyiapkan dan merekap Sales Quotation serta dokumen penawaran.

  2. Mengelola dan memperbarui database pelanggan.

  3. Memproses Sales Order serta berkoordinasi dengan tim terkait mengenai ketersediaan stok.

  4. Menyiapkan dokumen penjualan, seperti Surat Jalan, Invoice, dan dokumen pendukung lainnya.

  5. Melakukan koordinasi dengan tim logistik untuk proses pengiriman barang.

  6. Melakukan follow-up administrasi penjualan dan penagihan (collection) kepada pelanggan.

  7. Menyusun laporan administrasi penjualan secara berkala.

  8. Memberikan dukungan administrasi kepada tim Sales agar proses penjualan berjalan dengan lancar.


Kualifikasi

Kami mencari kandidat yang memiliki:

  1. Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 dari semua jurusan (Administrasi, Manajemen, Akuntansi, atau jurusan terkait lebih diutamakan).

  2. Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Sales Admin, Admin Penjualan, atau posisi administrasi lainnya.

  3. Terampil menggunakan Microsoft Office, terutama Microsoft Excel.

  4. Memiliki kemampuan administrasi, dokumentasi, dan pengarsipan yang baik.

  5. Teliti, rapi, mampu mengatur prioritas pekerjaan, dan memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik.

  6. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.


Benefit

  1. Gaji kompetitif.

  2. BPJS Kesehatan & BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.

  3. Bonus berdasarkan kinerja dan performance.

  4. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional dan suportif.

  5. Kesempatan belajar dan berkembang bersama perusahaan yang terus bertumbuh.


Tentang PT Graithlene Sukses Indonesia

PT Graithlene Sukses Indonesia adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang solusi alat ukur warna (Color Measurement Solutions) dan merupakan authorized distributor berbagai merek internasional terkemuka.

Kami melayani berbagai industri seperti:

  • Plastik

  • Cat & Coating

  • Tekstil

  • Otomotif

  • Makanan & Minuman

  • Kemasan

  • Pulp & Paper

  • Kosmetik

  • Farmasi

  • Building Material

Dengan pengalaman dan komitmen terhadap kualitas, kami terus menghadirkan solusi terbaik melalui produk premium serta layanan purna jual yang profesional.


Siap Bergabung dengan Kami?

Jika Anda adalah pribadi yang teliti, terorganisir, dan menyukai pekerjaan administrasi, kami mengundang Anda untuk bergabung bersama PT Graithlene Sukses Indonesia sebagai Sales Administration.

Kirimkan lamaran Anda sekarang dan jadilah bagian dari tim kami!

jobs.title: BARISTA
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Menyiapkan dan menyajikan minuman kopi berkualitas tinggi, termasuk espresso, cappuccino, latte, dan specialty drinks sesuai dengan standar resep yang telah ditetapkan. Mengoperasikan mesin espresso, grinder, dan peralatan barista lainnya dengan efisien dan memastikan pemeliharaan rutin untuk menjaga kualitas. Memberikan layanan pelanggan yang luar biasa dengan sikap yang ramah, penuh perhatian, dan profesional kepada setiap tamu yang datang. Menjelaskan menu minuman kepada pelanggan dan memberikan rekomendasi berdasarkan preferensi mereka. Menjaga kebersihan dan organisasi area bar, termasuk peralatan, counter, dan area kerja. Menangani transaksi pembayaran dengan akurat dan mengoperasikan sistem point-of-sale. Berkolaborasi dengan tim dapur dan staf lainnya untuk memastikan operasional yang lancar dan harmonis. Memastikan kesegaran bahan-bahan, mengikuti protokol keamanan pangan, dan memperhatikan tanggal kadaluarsa produk. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Barista di kafe, restoran, atau establishment minuman yang sejenis. Pengetahuan mendalam tentang berbagai jenis biji kopi, teknik brewing, dan profil rasa yang berbeda. Keahlian dalam mengoperasikan mesin espresso dan peralatan barista profesional lainnya. Kemampuan untuk membuat latte art dan presentasi minuman yang menarik secara visual. Keahlian komunikasi yang sangat baik dan kemampuan interpersonal untuk berinteraksi dengan pelanggan dari berbagai latar belakang. Perhatian terhadap detail dan standar kualitas yang tinggi dalam setiap minuman yang disajikan. Kemampuan multitasking dan bekerja dengan efisien dalam lingkungan yang sibuk. Sertifikasi Barista atau pelatihan profesional terkait adalah nilai tambah. Fleksibilitas untuk bekerja pada shift yang berbeda-beda, termasuk pagi, sore, dan akhir pekan sesuai kebutuhan operasional.

jobs.title: Kasir
jobs.description: Melayani proses transaksi penjualan dengan cepat, tepat, dan ramah. Mengoperasikan mesin kasir, sistem POS (Point of Sales), serta metode pembayaran tunai maupun non-tunai. Membuat laporan penjualan dan rekap kas harian secara akurat. Memberikan informasi produk, promo, dan program toko kepada pelanggan. Menjaga kebersihan dan kerapihan area kasir. Memastikan display produk tertata dengan baik. Melakukan pengecekan stok opname Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK sederajat, D3/S1 semua jurusan di persilakan melamar Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang retail fashion, khususnya sebagai kasir, admin toko, atau stock controller. Memahami alur stock opname, stock control, dan inventory management secara menyeluruh. Terbiasa melakukan pengecekan keluar masuk barang, pencocokan stok fisik dengan sistem, serta monitoring selisih stok. Memiliki kemampuan administrasi stok dan pelaporan inventory dengan baik dan akurat. Memahami penggunaan sistem POS (Point of Sales) dan pencatatan stok barang. Teliti, detail-oriented, dan memiliki tingkat akurasi tinggi dalam pengelolaan stok serta transaksi. Terbiasa bekerja dengan target penjualan dan deadline stock opname berkala. Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja secara individu maupun tim. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift, bekerja di hari libur nasional dan di hari weekend

jobs.title: Sales Lapangan
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan : Membangun kemitraan dengan pelaku usaha melalui pendekatan lapangan. Mengarahkan proses aktivasi layanan pembayaran digital dan solusi kasir sesuai kebutuhan merchant. Memberikan rekomendasi produk berdasarkan analisis kebutuhan bisnis pelanggan. Mengoptimalkan pencapaian target akuisisi dan penjualan yang telah ditetapkan. Memastikan merchant aktif menggunakan layanan setelah proses registrasi selesai. Menentukan area prospek potensial dan melaksanakan kegiatan akuisisi secara terencana. Memperbarui data prospek serta perkembangan aktivitas penjualan melalui sistem CRM. Kualifikasi : Memiliki pengalaman di bidang penjualan lapangan minimal satu tahun. Berpengalaman melakukan akuisisi pelanggan secara langsung (canvassing) menjadi syarat utama. Mampu mengoperasikan aplikasi digital dan memahami ekosistem layanan berbasis teknologi. Berorientasi pada hasil serta memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan negosiasi yang efektif. Terbiasa melakukan presentasi produk, mencari prospek baru, dan mengelola data penjualan menggunakan CRM. Memiliki kendaraan pribadi beserta SIM C yang masih berlaku. Dapat bergabung dalam waktu dekat.

jobs.description: We Are Hiring - Customer Service Lokasi : Pamulang, Tangerang Selatan. Di RA Clinic+, kami tidak sekadar melayani pelanggan. Kami mendampingi perjalanan pemulihan kulit mereka — dengan ilmu dan empati. Jujur, teliti, bertanggung jawab, disiplin, dan kuat di adminstrasi (Ms. Excel wajib) Terbiasa bekerja dengan target & sistem (CRM menjadi nilai tambah). jobs.title: Senior Tax
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari seorang Senior Tax yang berpengalaman dan profesional untuk bergabung dengan tim Akuntansi kami. Sebagai Senior Tax, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengelola semua aspek perpajakan perusahaan, termasuk perencanaan pajak, kepatuhan peraturan, dan optimalisasi pajak. Posisi ini memerlukan keahlian mendalam dalam regulasi pajak Indonesia, pemahaman yang kuat tentang berbagai jenis pajak, dan kemampuan untuk memberikan solusi pajak yang efisien bagi organisasi. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi fulltime yang berbasis di Jakarta Raya , dan menawarkan kesempatan untuk mengembangkan kepemimpinan dan pengaruh strategis dalam organisasi kami. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola strategi perpajakan perusahaan secara keseluruhan, termasuk perencanaan pajak tahunan dan pengelolisan risiko pajak. Mempersiapkan dan menyampaikan laporan pajak berkala, termasuk SPT (Surat Pemberitahuan) dan dokumen perpajakan lainnya sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundangan yang berlaku. Memastikan kepatuhan penuh terhadap semua peraturan dan perundangan pajak nasional dan lokal, serta melakukan audit internal untuk meminimalkan risiko. Memberikan konsultasi dan rekomendasi kepada manajemen mengenai implikasi pajak dari keputusan bisnis dan transaksi korporat. Mengelola hubungan dengan otoritas pajak, termasuk komunikasi dengan Direktorat Jenderal Pajak dan penyelesaian permasalahan pajak. Melakukan analisis pajak untuk mengidentifikasi peluang penghematan pajak yang legal dan efisien. Mengawasi dan membimbing tim junior dalam pelaksanaan tugas-tugas perpajakan sehari-hari. Mengikuti perkembangan terbaru dalam kebijakan perpajakan dan memastikan organisasi tetap compliant dengan perubahan regulasi. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal Sarjana (S1) dalam bidang Akuntansi, Perpajakan, Hukum Pajak, atau disiplin ilmu terkait dari institusi yang terakreditasi. Minimal 4 tahun pengalaman kerja di bidang perpajakan, dengan setidaknya 2 tahun dalam posisi senior atau kepemimpinan. Sertifikasi profesional seperti Brevet A dan Brevet B dari Direktorat Jenderal Pajak, atau sertifikasi perpajakan lainnya yang diakui. Pengetahuan mendalam tentang regulasi perpajakan Indonesia, termasuk Undang-Undang Pajak Penghasilan, Pajak Pertambahan Nilai, dan peraturan perpajakan lainnya. Pengalaman dalam menangani kasus-kasus pajak kompleks, termasuk transfer pricing dan pajak internasional. Kemampuan analitis yang kuat dengan perhatian terhadap detail dan akurasi tinggi dalam penanganan data dan laporan. Keterampilan komunikasi yang sangat baik, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis dalam bahasa Indonesia dan Inggris. Kemampuan kepemimpinan dan manajemen tim yang terbukti dengan pengalaman mengelola dan membimbing staf. Penguasaan software akuntansi dan perpajakan terkini, serta kemampuan menggunakan Microsoft Excel di tingkat lanjutan. Pemahaman tentang praktik bisnis secara umum dan kemampuan untuk memberikan perspektif strategis pada isu-isu perpajakan. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta kemampuan kandidat Tunjangan kesehatan yang komprehensif mencakup asuransi kesehatan untuk karyawan dan keluarga Tunjangan hari raya, bonus kinerja, dan insentif berbasis performa Kesempatan pengembangan karier yang jelas dengan program pelatihan dan sertifikasi profesional Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung dengan tim yang profesional dan supportif Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memenuhi kualifikasi di atas dan tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim kami sebagai Senior Tax di Hasta Buana Raya, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang . Kirimkan CV, surat motivasi, dan portofolio profesional Anda kepada kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih lanjut dan mempertimbangkan Anda sebagai bagian dari tim kami yang terus berkembang.

jobs.title: Supervisor HRD
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Mengawasi dan mengelola seluruh aktivitas HR, mulai dari rekrutmen, onboarding, administrasi karyawan, hingga pengembangan SDM. Menyusun dan mengimplementasikan kebijakan serta SOP Human Resources. Memastikan kepatuhan perusahaan terhadap peraturan ketenagakerjaan yang berlaku. Mengelola proses penilaian kinerja (Performance Appraisal) dan evaluasi karyawan. Menangani hubungan industrial (Industrial Relations), termasuk penyelesaian permasalahan ketenagakerjaan. Mengawasi proses payroll, absensi, cuti, lembur, BPJS, dan administrasi kepegawaian. Menganalisis kebutuhan tenaga kerja serta menyusun strategi rekrutmen yang efektif. Mengembangkan program pelatihan dan pengembangan kompetensi karyawan. Membuat laporan HR secara berkala kepada manajemen. Memimpin dan membina tim HR agar mencapai target serta KPI yang telah ditetapkan. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 Psikologi, Manajemen SDM, Hukum, atau jurusan terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Supervisor HRD atau posisi setara. Memahami proses HR secara menyeluruh (Recruitment, Training, Performance Management, Payroll, Compensation & Benefit, dan Industrial Relations). Memahami UU Ketenagakerjaan dan regulasi ketenagakerjaan di Indonesia. Memiliki kemampuan leadership, komunikasi, negosiasi, dan problem solving yang baik. Terbiasa membuat laporan HR menggunakan Microsoft Excel dan Microsoft Office. Mampu bekerja dengan target, teliti, serta memiliki integritas tinggi. jobs.title: Head of Project Coordination
jobs.description: Qualifications : Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in construction project management, with at least 5 years in a senior management role. Proven experience managing multiple facade, curtain wall, aluminum, glazing, or building envelope projects simultaneously. Demonstrated leadership experience overseeing Project Managers and multidisciplinary project teams. Strong knowledge of project planning, contract administration, budgeting, risk management, procurement, and construction execution. Excellent leadership, decision-making, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Excellent communication skills in both written and spoken English. Job Description : Lead and manage the Project Coordination Department, overseeing all Project Managers across multiple facade construction projects. Provide strategic direction and operational leadership to ensure all projects are executed safely, efficiently, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual and quality requirements. Supervise, mentor, and evaluate Project Managers, ensuring consistent project management practices and high team performance. Review and approve project execution plans, schedules, resource allocation, budgets, and recovery plans prepared by Project Managers. Monitor the overall performance of all ongoing projects, identifying risks, delays, and cost overruns, and implement corrective actions when necessary. Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Production, Logistics, and Site Operations to ensure effective cross-functional collaboration. Act as the primary escalation point for major project issues, commercial matters, and client concerns that cannot be resolved at the project level. Establish and standardize project management procedures, reporting systems, and performance metrics across all projects. Conduct regular project review meetings with Project Managers and senior management to monitor progress, resolve issues, and ensure achievement of company objectives. Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, company policies, quality standards, and Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) regulations. Support business development and tender teams by providing project planning, resource forecasting, execution strategies, and technical input during the bidding process. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, main contractors, and key stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery and customer satisfaction. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project delivery, operational efficiency, and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Financial & Cost Control Analyst Supervisor
jobs.description: The Financial & Cost Control Analyst Supervisor is responsible for overseeing financial planning, cost analysis (including COGM/COGS), budget control, and financial reporting processes within a manufacturing environment . This role bridges operational production data with management's strategic decision-making, ensuring cost efficiency and accuracy in financial reporting across the manufacturing operations. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Planning & Budgeting Develop and coordinate the annual budgeting process with related departments (production, procurement, operations) Prepare forecasts and budget revisions based on actual trends Monitor budget realization vs. plan and provide improvement recommendations 2. Financial Analysis & Cost Control (COGM/COGS) Calculate and analyze Cost of Goods Manufactured (COGM) and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Analyze production cost variances (material, labor, overhead) against standards/budget Identify cost drivers and cost efficiency opportunities across production lines Perform product costing and profitability analysis by product/line 3. Project Financial Monitoring (Manufacturing) Monitor the financial performance of manufacturing projects (capex, line expansions, etc.) Track budget vs. actual project costs Coordinate with project teams to ensure cost control aligns with timeline and budget 4. Cash Flow Monitoring Monitor operational cash flow and projected funding needs Prepare cash flow forecasts and provide early warning of potential liquidity gaps 5. Risk Management Identify financial risks related to raw material price fluctuations, currency exchange, and manufacturing operations Develop risk mitigation strategies and provide recommendations to management 6. Reporting & Compliance Prepare periodic management financial reports (monthly/quarterly) Ensure compliance with internal policies, SOPs, and applicable financial regulations Coordinate with internal/external audit teams on cost control matters Requirements Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics from a reputable university Minimum 3-5 years of experience in financial planning, financial analysis, or accounting Experience in the manufacturing , construction, or project-based industry is preferred Strong analytical and financial modeling skills Good knowledge of budgeting, cost control, and financial reporting Proficient in Microsoft Excel and financial systems (ERP preferred, e.g. SAP, Oracle) Good communication and cross-departmental coordination skills Solid understanding of COGM & COGS calculation and cost accounting in a manufacturing setting Nice to have: Proficiency in English (spoken & written) Please send your application letter with your latest resume, stating your qualifications, summary of experience, current & expected salary, and other supporting documents no later than two weeks from the date of this advertisement to: Jl. Raya Kebayoran Lama Pal. 7 No. 31, Jakarta 12210 Only qualified candidates will be notified for further selection.

jobs.title: Site Acquisition / Expansion Specialist (F&B)
jobs.description: Annyeong! 👋 Kalau kamu orang yang suka explore lokasi baru, jago negosiasi, dan punya insting tajam buat cari spot bisnis potensial… mungkin posisi ini bisa jadi next step buat kamu! PT Bighot Restaurant Indonesia (REDDOG) is hiring - Site Acquisition/Expansion Specialist (F&B) ✨Apa yang akan kamu lakukan? Menganalisis dan mengevaluasi lokasi potensial untuk ekspansi cabang baru, mempertimbangkan faktor-faktor seperti demografi, daya tarik, dan kelayakan bisnis. Mengelola proses akuisisi lahan dan negosiasi sewa untuk lokasi baru, bekerja sama dengan tim hukum dan keuangan. Mengkoordinasikan proses pembangunan dan persiapan tempat untuk cabang baru, termasuk perizinan, konstruksi, dan pengadaan peralatan. Memantau kinerja operasional cabang baru setelah pembukaan dan memberikan rekomendasi untuk perbaikan. Bertindak sebagai penghubung utama antara tim pusat dan tim lapangan untuk memastikan implementasi strategi ekspansi yang efektif. Menganalisis data pasar dan tren industri untuk mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan baru. ✨Apa saja kualifikasi yang dibutuhkan? Gelar sarjana dalam bidang Manajemen, Real Estat, Properti, atau yang setara. Memiliki pengalaman dalam peran yang terkait dengan akuisisi lokasi, pengembangan real estat, atau pengelolaan ekspansi bisnis di sektor ritel atau makanan dan minuman. Pemahaman mendalam tentang lanskap ritel dan tren pasar di Indonesia. Keterampilan negosiasi yang handal dan kemampuan untuk menjalin hubungan dengan pemangku kepentingan eksternal. Pemikiran strategis, kemampuan analitis, dan keterampilan pemecahan masalah yang kuat. Kemampuan untuk bekerja di bawah tekanan dan mengelola beberapa proyek secara bersamaan. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik terhadap area komersial di berbagai kota/daerah di Indonesia. Memiliki koneksi dengan owner atau broker properti menjadi nilai plus. ⚠️𝐇𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐚 𝐤𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐚𝐧𝐠 𝐬𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐚𝐢 𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐚𝐧 𝐤𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐤𝐚𝐬𝐢 𝐲𝐚𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐤𝐚𝐧 𝐤𝐚𝐦𝐢 𝐡𝐮𝐛𝐮𝐧𝐠𝐢⚠️ Don't miss this chance! Yuk, gabung dengan tim PT Bighot Restaurant Indonesia (REDDOG) & Let's grow together in the F&B industry!🚀

jobs.title: Legal & Compliance Specialist
jobs.description: Job Summary The Legal & Compliance Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring that the organization operates in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards. This position is responsible for managing legal documentation, regulatory compliance, and corporate governance, particularly within the fintech and securities crowdfunding sectors. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Indonesian financial regulations, especially those governed by the Financial Services Authority (OJK), and demonstrate the ability to support business operations through legal advisory, risk mitigation, and compliance oversight. This role requires a proactive, detail-oriented professional capable of working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Responsibilities • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, including OJK and POJK regulations (POJK 57/2020 & POJK 17/2025). • Oversee capital market compliance in coordination with KSEI and custodian banks. • Conduct legal due diligence for prospective issuers, partners, and corporate structures. • Draft, review, and negotiate legal documents such as agreements, NDAs, MoUs, and legal opinions. • Provide legal advisory services to support strategic and operational business decisions. • Support dispute resolution and litigation processes, including coordination with external legal counsel. • Ensure adherence to governance standards, including AML/CTF and ESG compliance. • Monitor regulatory developments and provide recommendations for compliance improvements. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Operations, Technology, Risk, and Management. • Develop and maintain internal policies, procedures, and compliance frameworks. • Assist in regulatory reporting and licensing requirements related to fintech and capital markets. • Promote legal awareness and compliance best practices across the organization. Qualifications Must-Have Requirements • Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LL.B.); a Master of Laws (LL.M.) is a strong advantage. • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Legal, Compliance, Capital Markets, Fintech, or related industries. • Strong understanding of OJK Securities Crowdfunding (SCF) regulations and Indonesian financial laws. • Familiarity with capital market infrastructure, including KSEI and custodian banks. • Proven experience in contract drafting, legal analysis, and regulatory compliance. • Knowledge of POJK regulations, particularly POJK 57/2020 and POJK 17/2025. • Excellent communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English. • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. • High level of integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail. • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Preferred Qualifications • Experience working in fintech, securities crowdfunding, or financial services industries. • Professional certifications related to compliance, risk management, or corporate governance. • Experience liaising with regulators such as OJK and capital market institutions. • Knowledge of AML/CTF regulations, ESG frameworks, and corporate governance practices. • Experience coordinating with external legal counsel and regulatory bodies. The Legal & Compliance Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring that the organization operates in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards. This position is responsible for managing legal documentation, regulatory compliance, and corporate governance, particularly within the fintech and securities crowdfunding sectors.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Indonesian financial regulations, especially those governed by the Financial Services Authority (OJK), and demonstrate the ability to support business operations through legal advisory, risk mitigation, and compliance oversight. This role requires a proactive, detail-oriented professional capable of working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, including OJK and POJK regulations (POJK 57/2020 & POJK 17/2025).

• Oversee capital market compliance in coordination with KSEI and custodian banks.

• Conduct legal due diligence for prospective issuers, partners, and corporate structures.

• Draft, review, and negotiate legal documents such as agreements, NDAs, MoUs, and legal opinions.

• Provide legal advisory services to support strategic and operational business decisions.

• Support dispute resolution and litigation processes, including coordination with external legal counsel.

• Ensure adherence to governance standards, including AML/CTF and ESG compliance.

• Monitor regulatory developments and provide recommendations for compliance improvements.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Operations, Technology, Risk, and Management.

• Develop and maintain internal policies, procedures, and compliance frameworks.

• Assist in regulatory reporting and licensing requirements related to fintech and capital markets.

• Promote legal awareness and compliance best practices across the organization.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LL.B.); a Master of Laws (LL.M.) is a strong advantage.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in Legal, Compliance, Capital Markets, Fintech, or related industries.

• Familiarity with capital market infrastructure, including KSEI and custodian banks.

• Proven experience in contract drafting, legal analysis, and regulatory compliance.

• Knowledge of POJK regulations, particularly POJK 57/2020 and POJK 17/2025.

• Excellent communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• High level of integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in fintech, securities crowdfunding, or financial services industries.

• Professional certifications related to compliance, risk management, or corporate governance.

• Experience liaising with regulators such as OJK and capital market institutions.

• Knowledge of AML/CTF regulations, ESG frameworks, and corporate governance practices.

• Experience coordinating with external legal counsel and regulatory bodies.

Key Attributes

• Strong ethical standards and professional integrity.

• Detail-oriented with excellent analytical and critical thinking skills.

• Proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented mindset.

• Excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines efficiently.

• Strong collaboration skills across legal, operational, and technical teams.

• Commitment to continuous learning and regulatory excellence.

Actively identify replacement opportunities for competitor products and expand AMG's presence within customer plants Visit customer sites to understand their processes and identify opportunities for AMG's products and solutions. Maintain customer visit reports, project pipeline, and sales activities. Achieve agreed business development and sales objectives. Customer-oriented, proactive, self-driven, and passionate about developing new business and customer opportunities. Willing to continuously learn industrial processes and instrumentation products. Work with internationally recognized industrial instrumentation brands. Receive product training directly from overseas principals. Mampu bekerja sama dengan tim dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik.

jobs.title: Medical Service Engineering
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami PT Surya Andra Medicalindo mencari Medical Service Engineer untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Jakarta Raya. Dalam posisi ini, Anda akan memainkan peran kunci dalam memastikan efisiensi dan keandalan peralatan medis kami, berkontribusi pada upaya kami untuk memberikan layanan kesehatan berkualitas tinggi kepada customer kami. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melakukan pemeliharaan, perbaikan, dan perawatan rutin pada peralatan medis, memastikan semua peralatan berfungsi dengan baik dan aman sesuai dengan standar industri. Mengidentifikasi dan menyelesaikan masalah teknis yang timbul dengan peralatan medis, meningkatkan waktu pakai dan kinerja peralatan. Mengembangkan dan menerapkan prosedur pemeliharaan pencegahan untuk meminimalkan downtime peralatan. Bekerja sama dengan tim medis dan tim layanan lainnya untuk memahami kebutuhan dan menyediakan solusi yang sesuai. Memantau persediaan suku cadang dan bahan habis pakai, memastikan ketersediaan yang memadai. Memberikan pelatihan dan dukungan teknis kepada pengguna peralatan medis. Memelihara catatan dan dokumentasi yang rapi tentang semua aktivitas pemeliharaan dan perbaikan. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Memiliki gelar Diploma atau Sarjana dalam Teknik Mesin (ATEM & STR) atau bidang terkait. Minimal 3 tahun pengalaman dalam peran serupa di lingkungan rumah sakit atau industri medis. Pemahaman yang mendalam tentang prinsip-prinsip teknik dan kemampuan untuk memecahkan masalah teknis secara efektif. Mahir dalam penggunaan alat-alat dan peralatan pengujian untuk diagnosis dan perbaikan peralatan medis. Pengetahuan tentang standar keselamatan dan regulasi yang berlaku untuk peralatan medis. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis, untuk berinteraksi dengan tim medis dan nonmedis. Memiliki pemikiran analitis, berorientasi pada detail, dan kemampuan untuk bekerja dengan tim maupun mandiri. Manfaat Utama Gaji yang kompetitif dan tunjangan yang menarik Asuransi kesehatan komprehensif dan program pensiun yang kuat Kesempatan untuk pengembangan karier dan pelatihan yang berkelanjutan Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung dan kolaboratif Waktu cuti tahunan yang menarik dan fleksibilitas kerja Tentang Kami PT Surya Andra Medicalindo adalah perusahaan terkemuka di bidang layanan kesehatan di Indonesia. Kami berkomitmen untuk memberikan perawatan medis yang unggul dengan menggunakan teknologi mutakhir dan tim profesional yang berdedikasi. Budaya perusahaan kami menekankan kerjasama tim, inovasi, dan orientasi pada pelayanan yang prima. Kami bangga menjadi tempat kerja yang menyediakan kesempatan yang setara dan mendukung keberagaman. Jika Anda tertarik dan memenuhi persyaratan, lamar sekarang untuk bergabung dengan tim kami yang dinamis di PT Surya Andra Medicalindo'!

jobs.title: Content Creator Speciallist
jobs.description: PT. Bukit Berkah Anyer merupakan anak perusahaan dengan brand Isykariman Property Syariah dan produk terkenal seperti Granada Riverside Resort, Granada Ocean Resort, Mangrood Land merupakan Developer Properti yang berbasis Syariah. Projectnya berupa Rukos, Kavling dan Perumahan yang tersebar di 25 wilayah Pulau Jawa dan Sumatera. Bukan hanya mengejar untung dalam menjalankan bisnis, namun keberkahan yang utama dalam setiap kegiatannya; tidak bertentangan dengan Qur'an dan Hadits. Suksesnya visi dan misi yang mulia ini tentu didukung oleh SDM yang handal di dalamnya. Mari bergabung bersama Isykariman. Tanggung Jawab Mengembangkan dan menciptakan berbagai jenis konten digital seperti artikel, video, infografis, dan lainnya yang sesuai dengan strategi pemasaran dan branding Perusahaan. Berkolaborasi dengan Tim Advertiser dan Sales untuk memahami kebutuhan target audiens dan menciptakan konten yang relevan dan menarik. Mengoptimalkan konten untuk meningkatkan visibilitas dan keterlibatan di berbagai kanal digital seperti website, media sosial, dan lainnya. Memantau tren industri dan inovasi konten digital untuk memberikan saran dan masukan yang membangun. Memastikan kualitas dan konsistensi branding dalam semua materi yang dihasilkan. Mengelola beberapa proyek secara efisien dan tepat waktu. Persyaratan Pengalaman sebagai Content Creator minimal 2 tahun (Nilai plus jika pernah di Perusahaan Properti) Pemahaman yang kuat tentang tren dan strategi konten digital, serta kemampuan untuk menghasilkan konten yang menarik secara visual dan memikat. Mahir dalam menggunakan perangkat lunak desain seperti Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) dan alat konten digital lainnya. Memiliki kemampuan yang baik dalam menulis, editing, dan optimasi konten. Kreatif, berorientasi pada detail, dan mampu bekerja dengan tenggat waktu. Kemampuan berkolaborasi dalam tim dan berkomunikasi dengan baik. Rutin menjalankan ibadah shalat 5 waktu dan ibadah sunnah Opsi lokasi kerja: Garut Benefit Gaji Bulanan Tunjangan Kesehatan Bonus Disiplin dan Bonus Kinerja Pinjaman Kasbon Non Riba Kajian Rutin Pekanan Lingkungan kerja yang positif dengan budaya yang sesuai dengan Al Qur'an dan Sunnah Jenjang Karir

jobs.title: Finance & Accounting Specialist
jobs.description: Qualification: Minimum Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 1–2 years of working experience in Finance or Accounting. Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable processes, AR aging analysis, collection procedures, and customer account reconciliation. Familiar with Indonesian taxation, particularly VAT, e-Faktur, and the Coretax system. Hands-on experience using Accurate Online and Jurnal.id accounting softwares. Proficient in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, IF, and other advanced formulas). Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Able to work independently, prioritize multiple tasks, and meet collection and reporting deadlines. Job Description: ​Manage the end-to-end Accounts Receivable (AR) process, including customer invoicing, payment application, and maintaining accurate customer balances. Prepare, issue, and monitor invoices, tax invoices (Faktur Pajak), debit notes, credit notes while ensuring all documents are complete and accurate. Maintain and monitor AR aging reports, follow up on overdue accounts through email, phone, or customer visits, and coordinate with Sales Team to ensure timely collections. Record receipts accurately, perform bank and account reconciliations, investigate receipt discrepancies, and ensure all receipts are properly matched to invoices. Operate the Coretax system for tax-related activities, including generating and managing e-Faktur, monitoring tax documents, and ensuring compliance with Indonesian tax regulations.

jobs.title: Product Buyer Specialist (Cosmetics)
jobs.description: Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field, with over 3 years of experience in skincare category recruitment or operations, preferably in retail channel (skincare) categories. Familiarity with skincare, beauty, and personal care, with resources in (local + overseas) brands and categories. In-depth knowledge of related industry clusters, product pricing, and brands, along with a certain level of merchant resources. Strong analytical skills, proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, and the ability to analyze industry trends and manage projects through data. Excellent business and communication skills, strong negotiation abilities, and resource development capabilities to effectively mobilize merchant resources. Strong learning ability, execution, self-motivation, teamwork, and result-oriented approach. Job Descriptions: Responsible for acquisition in standard categories (skincare, beauty, personal care), acquiring beauty brand merchants (local + overseas) to join the platform. Develop and execute detailed development plans based on the company’s product planning for each category, driving new product launches and implementation. Handle merchant cooperation negotiations and contracts, and follow up on all tasks related to brand onboarding to ensure a smooth process. Actively conduct market research and merchant analysis, promptly feedback market information, and provide effective business insights. Maintain good post-onboarding communication and cooperation with brands, collaborate with relevant departments to achieve monthly planning and product launch tasks, and meet KPIs (sales targets, brand onboarding, cost control, and profitability).

jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior / Lead UI/UX Designer with a deep obsession for Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) / and / or Email marketing. In this role, you won't just make things look good—you will design digital experiences engineered to convert. You will take full ownership of UI/UX direction across custom web applications and high-growth e-commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce). Working closely with developers, strategists, and clients, you will lead projects from low-fidelity wireframes to pixel-perfect, scalable design systems. If you thrive on analyzing user behavior, managing design workflows autonomously, and seeing your designs drive real revenue growth, this role is built for you. Key Responsibilities Own the full product design lifecycle—from user research, wireframing, and interactive prototyping to final visual design and developer handoff. Analyze user journeys, heatmaps, and performance data to design high-converting landing pages, seamless checkout funnels, and optimized UX flows. Create scalable, component-based design systems and UI kits in Figma to ensure consistency across web apps and e-commerce platforms. Organize design backlogs, set realistic execution timelines, and keep projects moving efficiently using our project management tools. Communicate design rationale, CRO strategies, and user testing insights clearly to clients, developers, and internal team members in English. Work on performance-driven visual initiatives, occasionally translating core brand aesthetics into high-impact marketing touchpoints. Other related responsabilities Why You’ll Love Working With Us No micro-management. You own your projects and see the direct outcome of your strategies. Work alongside sharp developers and strategists on cutting-edge e-commerce, web apps, and AI integrations. We value continuous learning, direct feedback, and giving our team the tools they need to succeed.

jobs.title: Social Media Community Officer
jobs.description: Mengelola komunitas driver di media sosial secara end-to-end sesuai kebijakan dan proses yang berlaku. Memonitor serta menganalisis keluhan, sentimen, dan isu yang sedang berkembang di media sosial. Memberikan respons yang cepat, jelas, dan solutif terhadap pertanyaan maupun keluhan driver melalui Facebook Group dan platform digital lainnya. Memastikan komunitas online berjalan dengan kondusif serta seluruh anggota mematuhi aturan komunitas. Menyusun laporan terkait tren keluhan, aktivitas komunitas, dan insight dari media sosial sebagai bahan evaluasi. Mengolah data menggunakan Google Sheets/Excel untuk kebutuhan monitoring dan reporting.

jobs.title: Growth & Partnership Manager
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities: Lead and develop the Offline & Online Activation team. Plan and execute activation programs in malls, offices, universities, community events and webinar with brand/Key Opinion Leader. Ensure activation targets and Return on Investment are achieved. Lead project and timeline management, able to supervise the short and long team game play on the activation offline marketing plan, including manage the sustainability of the plan. Build strategic partnerships with universities, government institutions, corporate companies, brands, and ommunities. Create co-marketing campaigns; product barter, brand placement, sponsorship for maximizing student acquisition opportunities and brand awareness. Identify partnership opportunities for expansion into new cities. Develop and execute integrated offline and online activation strategies to generate qualified leads through strategic partnerships, collaborative events, joint promotions, product barter initiatives, and other acquisition channels. Develop and oversee all activation and partnership align with the brand-communication, marketing strategy, and campaign objectives. Monitor and analyse campaign performance, identifying areas for improvement and providing ROI reports to demonstrate the effectiveness of activation efforts Manage the activation budget, ensuring optimal resource allocation and cost efficiency. Identify and explore new partnership opportunities that drive student acquisition and strengthen brand awareness. Optimize lead conversion from activation activities into student enrollments by continuously evaluating campaign performance and improving activation effectiveness. Collaborate closely with the Telemarketing and Sales teams to ensure alignment on campaign objectives, lead quality, and conversion performance. Oversee the production and distribution of marketing materials to support brand initiatives. Develop and implement standard operating procedures to ensure consistent execution and compliance. Create and supervise merchandising, ensuring effective stock, placement and execution. Prepare regular business reviews and performance reports for both internal management and external partners Initiate Corporate Social Responsibility programs aligned with the company brand values. Organize educational events that strengthen public relations and brand awareness. Build relationships with media and local stakeholders.

Dalam peran ini, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk mengelola dan mengembangkan program pelatihan dan pengembangan bagi agen penjualan kami, serta memastikan kinerja tim penjualan di wilayah Anda. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Sarjana dalam bidang Manajemen, Pemasaran, atau bidang terkait. Fresh Graduate welcome to apply Kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat, dengan keterampilan komunikasi, motivasi, dan pengembangan tim yang efektif. Kemampuan beradaptasi dan bekerja dalam lingkungan yang cepat berubah. Bersedia mengikuti program selama 1 bulan di Surabaya dan bersedia di tempatkan di area MOJOKERTO, GRESIK, BOJONEGORO. jobs.title: Finance, Accounting, and Tax Officer
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan PT BPR Danamas membuka kesempatan bagi profesional yang memiliki ketelitian tinggi, kemampuan analisis yang baik, serta pemahaman di bidang keuangan dan perpajakan untuk bergabung sebagai Finance, Accounting, and Tax Officer . Tanggung jawab meliputi: Mengawasi dan mengelola aktivitas Finance, Accounting, dan Tax perusahaan. Memastikan penyusunan laporan keuangan dilakukan secara akurat dan tepat waktu. Mengawasi proses pencatatan seluruh transaksi keuangan sesuai standar akuntansi yang berlaku. Memastikan kepatuhan perpajakan perusahaan sesuai dengan regulasi yang berlaku. Menguasai Microsoft Excel tingkat lanjut (Expert Level) . Memahami proses penyusunan laporan keuangan dan perpajakan. Memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik, teliti, detail, serta bertanggung jawab. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas (mobile) apabila diperlukan. Benefit Gaji kompetitif. BPJS Kesehatan dan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. Kesempatan mengembangkan karier di industri perbankan. Lingkungan kerja profesional dan suportif.

jobs.description: WE ARE HIRING: MERCHANDISER COSTING Key Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Fashion Design, Textile Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Management, Accounting, Supply Chain Management, or a related field Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a Merchandiser Costing, Costing Merchandiser, Costing Staff, or similar role in the garment, textile, or fashion industry Strong understanding of product costing, material consumption analysis, garment manufacturing processes, and cost structure Familiar with garment materials, trims, and value-added manufacturing processes such as printing, embroidery, washing, and finishing Proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g. VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Table, IF, SUMIFS, and analytical formulas) and familiar with ERP systems Strong analytical, numerical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail Good communication and coordination skills with internal teams and suppliers Able to communicate in English, both written and spoken, for technical documents and supplier or buyer correspondence Job Summary Prepare accurate product costing and costing sheets based on product specifications, material consumption, production processes, and overhead costs Analyze Bill of Materials (BOM) , Tech Packs, and related product documentation to estimate material and production costs Develop commercial WE ARE HIRING: MERCHANDISER COSTING

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Fashion Design, Textile Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Management, Accounting, Supply Chain Management, or a related field

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a Merchandiser Costing, Costing Merchandiser, Costing Staff, or similar role in the garment, textile, or fashion industry

  • Strong understanding of product costing, material consumption analysis, garment manufacturing processes, and cost structure

  • Familiar with garment materials, trims, and value-added manufacturing processes such as printing, embroidery, washing, and finishing

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g. VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Table, IF, SUMIFS, and analytical formulas) and familiar with ERP systems

  • Strong analytical, numerical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

  • Good communication and coordination skills with internal teams and suppliers

  • Able to communicate in English, both written and spoken, for technical documents and supplier or buyer correspondence

Job Summary

  • Prepare accurate product costing and costing sheets based on product specifications, material consumption, production processes, and overhead costs

  • Analyze Bill of Materials (BOM), Tech Packs, and related product documentation to estimate material and production costs

  • Develop commercial pricing recommendations aligned with target margins and business objectives

  • Negotiate material prices and commercial terms with suppliers to achieve competitive product costs

  • Conduct cost variance analysis between estimated and actual production costs to support continuous improvement

  • Collaborate with Product Development, Merchandiser Sample, Pattern Maker, Industrial Engineering, Purchasing, and other related teams to validate costing assumptions

  • Support the preparation of quotations and commercial pricing proposals for internal decision-making and buyer negotiations

  • Maintain and update material pricing databases and costing information within the ERP system

  • Prepare periodic reports on product cost, margin analysis, and profitability performance

  • Monitor market trends, material price movements, and production costs to support competitive costing strategies

jobs.title: Budget Control Officer
jobs.description: We are looking for a detail-oriented Budget Control Officer to monitor budget utilization and ensure all expenditures comply with company policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Review purchase requests, corporate credit card expenses, reimbursement claims, and other documents to ensure budget compliance. Review budget proposals for new stores, non-routine projects, and additional or replacement budgets. Verify budget figures, cost breakdowns, and supporting documents. Prepare annual budget templates based on historical actual spending and cost assumptions. Maintain budget documentation and coordinate the approval process. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Accounting is mandatory. Minimum 1 year of experience as a Budget Control Officer or in a similar Budget Control role. Good understanding of budgeting, accounting, and cost control. Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities. Good written and spoken English. Placement: Synthesis Square, South Jakarta.

jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Assistant Manager
jobs.description: About the role As the Sales & Marketing Assistant Manager at one of our subsidiaries , you will support the Company's commercial growth by identifying new business opportunities, managing key customer relationships, and assisting in the execution of sales strategies. Working closely with the Sales & Marketing Manager, you will contribute to expanding the Company's B2B vehicle leasing business while delivering excellent customer service. This full-time position is based in South Jakarta, Jakarta . What you'll be doing Support the implementation of sales strategies to achieve business growth objectives. Develop new business opportunities and maintain long-term relationships with corporate customers. Manage the sales process from lead generation through proposal preparation, negotiation, and contract execution. Prepare commercial proposals, quotations, and customer presentations. Monitor customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for account expansion. Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely vehicle delivery and service quality. Prepare sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and market analysis. Monitor competitor activities and provide market intelligence to Management. Participate in business development initiatives, networking events, and customer meetings. Assist in coaching and supporting junior sales team members. What we're looking for Proficiency in English (oral and written) is a must. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 8 years of professional experience with at least 2 years in a supervisory or assistant managerial sales role. Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management. Experience in vehicle leasing, fleet management, automotive, transportation & logistics, equipment leasing, or related B2B service industries is highly preferred. Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills. Good understanding of commercial contracts and sales processes. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Self-motivated with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Willingness to travel as required. What we offer At PT Samindo Resources Tbk', we are committed to fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment that enables our employees to thrive. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Our focus on work-life balance ensures that our employees can maintain a healthy lifestyle and achieve their personal goals. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Understanding of web accessibility (WCAG), SEO, and frontend performance optimization. Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. Relevant certifications in Frontend Development or JavaScript frameworks are an advantage.

jobs.title: Creative Fashion Manager
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY : We are seeking an experienced and visionary Creative Fashion Manager to lead the end-to-end product development process while overseeing three core functions: Fashion Brand, Sourcing & Product Development, and Sample Room. This role is reporting to COO and responsible for driving seasonal product strategies, ensuring design excellence, managing cross-functional execution, and delivering commercially successful collections that align with the company's brand identity and business objectives. JOB DESCRIPTION : Lead and manage the Fashion Brand, Sourcing & Product Development, and Sample Room teams to ensure effective collaboration and seamless execution across the entire product development process. Develop seasonal collection strategies and creative concepts based on market trends, consumer insights, and business objectives. Drive trend forecasting, color direction, fabric innovation, silhouette development, and product assortment planning. Oversee the complete product lifecycle from concept, design, sourcing, sample development, approvals, and production handover. Ensure all products meet brand identity, quality standards, target costing, and customer expectations. Collaborate with Supply Chain, Sales, Ecommerce and Marketing to ensure timely product launches. Lead sourcing strategies by identifying suitable suppliers, fabrics, trims, and manufacturing solutions that balance quality, cost, and lead time. Oversee the daily operations of the Sample Room to ensure efficient sample development and sample development calendar by setting priorities based on business needs, seasonal launches, and critical deadlines. Supervise sample development, fitting sessions, garment construction reviews, and product refinements before production Work closely with Pattern Makers, Product Developers, and Designers to resolve technical issues during sample development. Review and approve design specifications, technical packages, BOMs, material selections, trims, artwork, and construction details. Evaluate product performance and market feedback to continuously improve future collections with other departments Establish and continuously improve product development processes, SOPs, and cross-functional workflows. Act as the primary point of contact for customer custom projects, managing communication with customers, aligning project requirements and expectations, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring successful execution from concept through final delivery. Prepare product presentations, development updates and KPIM reports REQUIREMENT : Minimum 10 years of experience in the fashion or apparel industry, including at least 5 years in a managerial or leadership role. Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams, preferably across Design, Sourcing & Product Development, and Sample Room functions. Strong knowledge of apparel product development, garment construction, pattern development, fitting, fabrics, trims, sourcing, and manufacturing processes. Solid understanding of product costing, quality standards, vendor management, and supply chain operations. Excellent project management, planning, and organizational abilities with the capacity to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Results-oriented, innovative, detail-focused, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced fashion environment.

jobs.title: Principal / Head of School
jobs.description: 🌿 WE’RE HIRING | Principal/Head of School 📍 Wira’s Playroom — Kemang, Jakarta Selatan “A Safe Space to Grow, A Trusted Place to Thrive.” Wira’s Playroom is an inclusive learning space where children grow with joy, dignity, and acceptance—supported holistically to become confident learners and individuals. We include: Special Needs School, Therapy Center, Early Intervention Program & Kindergarten to Primary 6. About the Role The Principal/Head of School serves as the institutional leader, positioned above the three core organizational pillars. Reporting directly to the Foundation's Board, you will build and maintain the school's strategy, standards, people decisions, financial sustainability, and safeguarding protocols. Rather than managing day-to-day vertical operations, you will lead strategically through three direct reports: the Clinical & Therapy Lead, the Education Lead, and the Operations Lead. Key Responsibilities Vision & Strategy: Own the school’s vision, values, and strategic direction. Set annual performance goals across all three pillars to ensure a unified, cohesive institution. Senior Leadership Rhythm: Supervise, develop, and hold the three pillar leads accountable. Establish and run senior leadership rhythms, meetings, and institutional priorities. Academic & Clinical Oversight: Hold overall accountability for student outcomes, teaching quality, and therapy standards through your specialized leads, ensuring high performance without micromanaging daily delivery. Culture, Induction & Training: Lead whole-school onboarding and institutional training focused on corporate values, culture, conduct, safeguarding, and operational procedures. Stakeholder Management & Escalation: Serve as the primary external face of the school to parents, regulators, and the community. Sit at the apex of the escalation line to handle the most critical institutional issues and determine board-level notifications. Governance, Finance & Safeguarding: Secure child safeguarding protocols, maintain ultimate regulatory/legal compliance, approve budgets, and guide the school's overall financial health and sustainability alongside the Operation Lead. Emergency Operational Support: Provide short-term classroom cover or supervision within your own competence during genuine emergencies to maintain safety and routine. (Does not replace credentialed clinical therapy delivery).

jobs.title: Hard Service Facilities Coordinator (English Speaking)
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Coordinate and monitor the daily performance of the Client infrastructure, understand the critical MEP systems including UPS, CRAC, HVAC, Chiller, Generators, Plumbing, Fire Safety Systems, and BMS (Building Management Systems). Supervise onsite technician and external contractors performing engineering, repair, and maintenance tasks. Manage, supervise and develop a close working relationship with third-party engineering contractors, ensuring all Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) and reactive tasks are completed to SLA standards. Conduct regular walkthroughs / inspections onsite Client premise to identify potential failures, safety hazards or areas for improvement, and ensure safety standards are complies with local building codes, environmental regulations, and occupational health and safety standards. Act as a central point of contact connecting technical operations with the wider site team and respond swiftly to equipment failures and incidents. Must be prepared to be on call and work out of normal working hours where applicable. Review vendor service reports, diagnose technical issues based on their findings, and recommend cost-effective solutions. Asset Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation for all technical equipment, warranties, service histories, and regulatory certificates. Permit-to-Work (PTW) management: Review and issue risk assessments and work method statements. Supporting stakeholders to any request related to facilities and coordinate special projects as directed by JLL or Client Qualifications & Experience Minimum Diploma in any related field, preferably in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering Minimum 3 years in Facilities Management field, experienced or have knowledge in technical operations works. Good communication skills (written and spoken english is mandatory) Ability to build good working relationships with Managers, Stakeholders, Landlords, Colleagues and Service providers.

jobs.title: Staff Marketing
jobs.description: Kami mencari Staff Marketing yang berpengalaman dan bersemangat untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT Tuju Kuda Hitam Sakti. Tanggung Jawab Menyiapkan dan mengelola dokumen ekspor (PIB, PEB, invoice, packing list, COO, Bill of landing, dll.) Menyiapkan dan menyediakan barang yang dipesan buyer untuk pengiriman ekspor. Berkoordinasi dengan tim/lintas tim, forwader beacukai, shipping line, dan pihak terkait. Mencari buyer luar negeri, bernegosiasi dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan calon buyer / buyer. Mengembangkan dan melaksanakan strategi pemasaran terintegrasi yang mencakup saluran digital dan tradisional untuk meningkatkan kesadaran merek. Mengelola kampanye pemasaran multi-channel, termasuk media sosial, email marketing, dan iklan digital, untuk mencapai target audiens yang tepat. Membuat konten pemasaran yang menarik dan relevan, termasuk copy, grafis, dan materi promosi yang selaras dengan pedoman merek perusahaan. Melakukan riset pasar dan analisis kompetitor untuk mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan dan tren industri terkini. Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal, termasuk tim penjualan dan produk, untuk memastikan pesan pemasaran yang konsisten dan efektif. Mengelola anggaran pemasaran dengan efisien dan melacak ROI dari setiap kampanye untuk optimasi berkelanjutan. Menganalisis data pemasaran dan metrik kinerja untuk memberikan laporan reguler dan rekomendasi perbaikan kepada manajemen. Mendukung event pemasaran, peluncuran produk, dan aktivitas promosi lainnya untuk memaksimalkan keterlibatan pelanggan. Persyaratan Gelar Sarjana dalam Pemasaran, Akuntansi, Komunikasi, Bisnis, atau bidang terkait. Usia maksimal 35th dan mampu berbahasa inggris. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman kerja di bidang pemasaran, komunikasi pemasaran, atau peran marketing yang relevan dan memahami regulasi, alur dan dokumen ekspor impor (PIB, PEB, invoice, packing list, COO, Bill of landing, dll.) Memahami proses kepabeanan, shipping dan prosedur logistic internasional. Terbiasa berkoordinasi dengan buyer, forwader, beacukai, shipping line, dan pihak terkait. Pemahaman yang kuat tentang strategi pemasaran digital, media sosial, saluran pemasaran online, teliti, komunikatif, bertanggung jawab serta mampu berkoordinasi lintas tim. Keahlian dalam menggunakan platform media sosial dan alat analitik pemasaran digital. Kemampuan komunikasi verbal dan tertulis yang sangat baik dalam bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris lebih disukai. Keterampilan analitis yang kuat dengan kemampuan menginterpretasikan data dan membuat keputusan berbasis insight. Kreativitas dan kemampuan problem-solving yang baik dalam mengembangkan kampanye inovatif. Kemampuan manajemen proyek dengan perhatian terhadap detail dan mampu mengelola prioritas multitasking. Pengalaman dengan Microsoft Office dan alat desain grafis dasar merupakan nilai tambah.

jobs.title: Rough Mill Supervisor
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT Good Wood Interior mencari seorang Rough Mill Supervisor yang berpengalaman dan kompeten untuk memimpin operasional Sawmill, Kiln Dry, Pembahanan kami di Kabupaten Jepara, Jawa Tengah. Sebagai Rough Mill Supervisor, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam memastikan efisiensi pembahanan, kualitas hasil kerja, dan keselamatan kerja di departemen rough mill. Posisi ini memerlukan kepemimpinan yang kuat, pemahaman mendalam tentang proses pengolahan kayu, dan kemampuan untuk mengelola tim yang dinamis. Ini adalah posisi kontrak yang menawarkan tanggung jawab signifikan dalam operasi manufaktur interior kayu berkualitas tinggi. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengawasi dan mengelola tim rough mill dalam melaksanakan aktivitas produksi harian, termasuk pengolahan kayu baku, pemotongan, dan persiapan material untuk tahap produksi berikutnya. Memastikan semua proses produksi berjalan sesuai dengan standar kualitas perusahaan, spesifikasi teknis, dan timeline yang telah ditetapkan. Menerapkan dan mengawasi protokol keselamatan kerja yang ketat untuk meminimalkan risiko kecelakaan dan memastikan lingkungan kerja yang aman bagi seluruh anggota tim. Memonitor dan mengoptimalkan penggunaan mesin dan kayu, serta memastikan pemeliharaan rutin dilakukan tepat waktu. Mengelola inventory material baku dan memastikan ketersediaan papan yang cukup untuk kelancaran produksi. Melatih, membimbing, dan mengembangkan anggota tim untuk meningkatkan keterampilan dan produktivitas mereka. Melaporkan progress produksi, mengidentifikasi hambatan, dan memberikan solusi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi operasional. Melakukan inspeksi berkala terhadap hasil kerja dan memastikan perbaikan berkelanjutan dalam kualitas dan output produksi. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen lain seperti Quality Control, PPIC, dan Maintenance untuk memastikan sinkronisasi operasional yang baik. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal 5 tahun pengalaman sebagai supervisor atau pemimpin tim di industri manufaktur, khususnya di bidang pengolahan kayu atau rough mill. Pemahaman mendalam tentang proses pengolahan kayu, spesifikasi material, mesin produksi, dan teknik quality control. Kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat dengan pengalaman mengelola tim 10-20 orang atau lebih. Pengetahuan tentang standar keselamatan kerja dan regulasi industri manufaktur, dengan track record implementasi program K3 yang baik. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik lisan maupun tertulis, dalam bahasa Indonesia. Keterampilan problem-solving dan pengambilan keputusan yang cepat dan tepat dalam situasi operasional yang kompleks. Pengetahuan tentang lean manufacturing atau continuous improvement principles adalah nilai tambah yang signifikan. Kemampuan menggunakan sistem informasi dan software produksi untuk monitoring dan pelaporan. Sertifikasi atau training di bidang manajemen produksi, keselamatan kerja, atau kepemimpinan adalah preferensi. Berpikiran analitis dengan perhatian terhadap detail dalam mengelola standar kualitas dan target produksi. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kinerja. Tunjangan kesehatan dan keselamatan kerja yang komprehensif. Kesempatan pengembangan karier dan pelatihan profesional berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan kompetensi. Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung inovasi dan perbaikan berkelanjutan. Kesempatan untuk bekerja dengan teknologi dan peralatan produksi modern di industri manufaktur interior kayu. Tim yang solid dan profesional dengan budaya kerja yang kolaboratif. Jaminan sosial dan tunjangan karyawan sesuai dengan peraturan perburuhan yang berlaku. Tentang PT Good Wood Interior PT Good Wood Interior adalah perusahaan terkemuka di industri manufaktur furniture yang berbasis di Kabupaten Jepara, Jawa Tengah—pusat industri mebel Indonesia yang terkenal secara internasional. Dengan dedikasi terhadap keunggulan dalam craftsmanship, desain inovatif, dan kualitas material, kami menghasilkan produk interior kayu berkualitas premium yang dipasarkan ke pasar nasional dan internasional. Perusahaan kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang mendukung pertumbuhan profesional karyawan dan menerapkan standar keselamatan kerja tertinggi. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan kami bergantung pada keahlian, dedikasi, dan inovasi tim kami. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan menjadi bagian dari perjalanan menuju keunggulan operasional di industri mebel Indonesia. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman relevan dan antusias untuk bergabung dengan tim PT Good Wood Interior sebagai Rough Mill Supervisor, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Kirimkan CV, surat motivasi, dan portfolio pengalaman Anda melalui portal aplikasi kami. Kami menantikan untuk bertemu dengan Anda dan membahas bagaimana Anda dapat berkontribusi pada kesuksesan kami.

jobs.title: Resources Geologist
jobs.description: Job responsibilities: Geological Modelling & Resource Evaluation: Manage geological databases and maintain data integrity. Develop geological models and block models. Prepare mineral resource estimations in accordance with recognised industry standards. Support resource classification and reserve conversion processes. Review drilling results and recommend additional exploration programmes. Technical Support: Provide geological and mine planning support to mining operations. Conduct ore control and grade reconciliation. Analyze deviations between mine plans and actual production. Recommend corrective actions to improve operational performance. Technical Due Diligence: Evaluate mining projects from both technical and economic perspectives. Support feasibility studies, project development, and investment analysis. Conduct technical due diligence for mining acquisitions and new project opportunities. Supervise field data collection including mapping, testpit, drilling and sampling activities. Reporting & Governance Ensure compliance of Good Mining Practice, and applicable regulations. Monitor departmental budgets and resource utilization. Lead continuous improvement initiatives within the Technical Services function. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Geology/Geological Engineering Minimum 5 years of experience in the exploration and evaluation of laterite nickel resources and reserves. Cross-commodity experience, such as coal and gold, is a plus. Experience managing mining operations and open-pit mine planning. Proficiency in mapping and resource and reserve estimation software (ArcGIS, Surpac, Leapfrog). Proficiency in scheduling software such as Vulcan and Minesched is a plus. Having a Class A driver's license (SIM A)

DIBUTUHKAN SEGERA! Hanya untuk yang SERIUS mencari kerja.
